content_text:
As a feature film DP, what do you think about the wave of remastering films in HDR and releasing on blue ray?
Is this done without the original director and dp? Does this change how the film was originally intended to be viewed, and how the cinematography feels? Or do you think this actually improves the film?
I don’t have specific films I am asking about since it is being done to many, but I am curious of your thoughts on this overall. Anyone is welcome to mention specific films!
